summary: Tested deposit-renewal independent-asset scope on public URL: backend regression passed (5/5), UI selectors/columns validated, and no renewal accounting side-effects found beyond new deposit entry.

ui_bugs.issue: Browser console shows hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' while rendering renewal options.

action_items: Fix renewal dropdown rendering to avoid invalid nested markup inside <option> (hydration warning).
After UI fix, rerun Playwright on /bank/industrial-development/register to confirm no console hydration errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Renewal flow in create_deposit correctly inserts a new deposit and only updates previous status/notes (no mutation of old amount/number/dates).
Journal posting path for renewal does not include renewal_notes and does not create an extra accounting entry for old deposit status update.
backend/server.py remains very large (>700 lines), increasing regression risk around accounting/reporting logic.
seed_data_creation: Automated tests created TEST-ITER74-* deposits and cleaned them via pytest autouse cleanup fixture (Mongo delete by prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed pytest suite covering renewal independence, statements period scope, trial balance term-deposit scope, and ledger opening-balance behavior. UI validated login -> deposit registration -> statements page with required data-testid fields/columns; only console hydration warning observed on renewal select options. ETA Electronic Invoice integration is MOCKED and out of this scope.
rca of the issue: RCA for UI warning: renewal options are rendered in a way that introduces a span wrapper under option at runtime (console reports invalid HTML child), likely from dynamic wrapper/instrumentation around option text. Reproduction: login -> /bank/industrial-development/register -> open page and inspect console. Mitigation: ensure option label renders plain text node only (no nested elements/wrappers).
